title: systemd Service Watchdog (check, restart with backoff, log outcome)
description: Checks that a systemd service is active; if not, tries restarting it up to N times with a delay between attempts (checking the real post-restart ActiveState each time, not just whether the restart command itself succeeded), and logs the final outcome via syslog if it never comes back.

variables.name: MAX_RESTART_ATTEMPTS
variables.prompt: Max restart attempts before giving up

variables.name: RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS
variables.prompt: Seconds to wait after a restart before checking again

toggles.name: ALERT_VIA_LOGGER
toggles.prompt: Also send a syslog alert (via logger) if it never comes back up
